description: Merge vectors for walletspace device sync, snapshot version 1 (docs/device-sync.md, 'Merge' and 'Canonical encoding'). Each case: snapshots -> merged. The merged snapshot must come out of every order and every grouping of the snapshots (merging some first, then the result with the rest). written_at is delivery metadata and not part of a merge result. Wallet records, times and tombstones of the merged snapshot are in normal form.

cases.name: the copy updated last wins the whole wallet
one instant written in two zones is a tie, settled by the greater canonical encoding
fractional seconds compare by instant and lose their trailing zeros
an index of 0 is part of the record, an absent index is not
an empty optional string is left out of the encoding
networks are a set, and no networks is no field
address keys are ordered by UTF-16 code units, and no addresses is an empty object
strings compare as the UTF-8 bytes of their JCS form
the name set last wins, a tie goes to the greater UTF-8 bytes, a default name has no time
key variants: one per distinct key, the earliest import, sorted by variant id
a deletion wins, takes every variant of a key, and keeps its latest time
wallets are ordered by creation instant then id, and the newer of two on one key is reported
